metadata.description: Outfit - a complete set of AI marketing, sales, and automation tools for Claude Code. Copywriting, email sequences, social content, AI creative, Google Workspace, and commerce, all driven by natural-language conversation.

plugins.name: ac-builder
plugins.description: Build ActiveCampaign email sequences from markdown via MJML. Skills wrap the bundled ac-builder Python CLI for rendering, validation, V1 campaign creation, V3 click-action wiring, and theme-driven multi-brand workflows.

plugins.name: linkedin-post-studio
plugins.description: Profile-driven LinkedIn content generation: text posts, carousels, hooks, polls, video scripts, newsletters, calendars, companion comments, QA review, idea mining, and content repurposing.

plugins.name: creators-studio
plugins.description: AI image and video Creative Director powered by best-in-class models: Gemini Nano Banana, Kling v3, VEO 3.1, ElevenLabs, Lyria.

plugins.name: scribe
plugins.description: Google Workspace orchestration for Claude Code. Multi-account access to Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Contacts, Tasks, Forms, and Chat. Ships 14 cross-service workflow commands plus 10 service skills. Wraps taylorwilsdon/google_workspace_mcp.

plugins.name: spiffy
plugins.description: Talk to the Spiffy checkout platform from Claude Code. Customer lookup, MRR and affiliate and churn reports, customer notes, and one-off promo code generation. Works with any Spiffy account, just supply your own API key.
